Network-based KEGG pathway enrichment analysis

Network-based KEGG pathway enrichment analysis. The shared interactors of CNR1 and CNR2 were significantly enriched in 12 KEGG pathways, ranked according to their FDR values. The first three were represented as ring charts surrounding the correlated nodes
